description: The custom AUDIENCES on a Snapchat ad account — customer lists, lookalikes, website-event (pixel) and engagement audiences — with approximate size, upload status and whether each can be targeted yet (READY, TOO_FEW_USERS, NOT_READY). Pass audienceId for one. Target them with create_snapchat_ads_ad_squad(audiences / excludeAudiences). Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

audienceId.description: one audience id to read; omit to list all

name: list_snapchat_ads_audiences
title: List Snapchat audiences
